cases.title: The Pit Schedule row of pit P3 shows its inlet and outlet invert levels (not blank), and they equal the IL texts on the plan; the schedule closes and changes nothing
cases.plan_item: Pit Schedule levels (triage groups S2 and S3; daily cards D21 and D23 neighbour); BUG-376
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-376 in BUG_CARPARK.md (found on DRV17_B1: row P3 had IL (Inlet) and IL (Outlet) blank while the plan showed IL 18.10 at the P3 end of a pipe; expected the schedule to carry the plan's levels) and with daily cards D21 and D23 (the schedule window is read, not edited). Not claimed: the other S2 and S3 bugs (BUG-098, BUG-694, BUG-780, BUG-784, BUG-786, BUG-965, BUG-246, BUG-779, BUG-785, BUG-807, BUG-869): they need cell edits, a twin-inlet drawing, a placed schedule or other data this fixture does not have.
cases.expected: PITSCHEDULE opens; the row of pit P3 reads FROM P4, inlet dia 450 with IL 17.30, outlet dia 450 with IL 17.25 and cover 18.88; the plan holds the texts IL 17.30 and IL 17.25 (the same levels); the Close button closes the window; the drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The schedule is built by the live window from the links in the real drawing, and the plan texts are real drawing objects.
not_automated: Which plan text belongs to which pipe end is not mapped: the case checks that the schedule's two numbers are among the IL texts drawn on the plan. Cell edits, Refresh and a placed (drawn) schedule are not driven (the grid cells have no accessible id).
That the window looks right is R25's Codex look; this case reads text only.

cases.proves_bugs: BUG-606 (CDCHECKDWG on the current drawing writes no report file beside the source drawing: the folder of the test copy gets only AutoCAD lock files and the CE backup; the report went to the CE logs folder on this PC instead)
cases.title: CDCHECKDWG on the current drawing prints one summary line (not a long dump), opens the results window, closes cleanly, and changes nothing in the drawing file
cases.plan_item: CDCHECKDWG (daily card D28; triage groups C2 and W2)
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with daily card D28 (assertions 1 to 4: the four CE lines in order, one summary line matching the layer recognition pattern, at most 5 new CE lines, window title and Close, one new report file beside the drawing, file hash unchanged). BUG-606 says that report file beside the drawing is wrong (approved CV07: reports go to the approved project report location); on 3.0.75 the command no longer prints "wrote report" and no file lands beside the drawing (the report went to the CE logs folder under %APPDATA%, folder TIM_CE_CADTOOLS, subfolder logs, subfolder checkdwg), which is the approved location BUG-606 asks for; the case therefore asserts "no report beside the drawing" instead of card step 4 (a new report file beside the drawing).
cases.expected: CDCHECKDWG with the empty answer prints "[CE] CDCHECKDWG: checking current drawing (...)", "[CE] CDCHECKDWG reading: <path>", exactly one summary line "[CE] CDCHECKDWG: <n>.<n>% layer recognition, <n> unrecognized layers, <n> QA findings ..." and "[CE] CDCHECKDWG wrote report: <path>" (four CE lines, no long dump); the report path is in the CE logs folder (logs eckdwg), not beside the drawing; the window "Check consultant drawing results (CDCHECKDWG)" opens and its Close button closes it; no report file appears beside the drawing (only AutoCAD lock files and the CE backup are new in the test-copy folder); the drawing file SHA-256 does not change.
cases.why_not_unit: The command reads a real DWG off disk and opens a live window.
not_automated: BUG-790 (design review ignoring office Settings) and BUG-801 (QA going stale) are NOT claimed. The window look is not judged. The "approved project report location" itself is not read: the case only shows that nothing is written beside the drawing.
The report the command now writes to the CE logs folder under %APPDATA% (TIM_CE_CADTOOLS, logs, checkdwg) on this PC is left there (each run adds one small text file); it is not read.
